Monster abilities

Original HOL creature capabilities. These are separate from learned character abilities: no DP, no player Discipline requirements, no automatic access from an animal form or a summoning category. Each creature supplies its own attack values. Shared attack templates describe attacker outcomes for authoring; the DA creature card prints the corresponding defense outcomes explicitly. The player reference prints attacker outcomes. Never ask the DA to convert a template’s result during play.

The creature entry prints complete action rules. Per-creature outcomes are authoritative where they specialize a shared template.

Reuse an existing capability when its trigger, target, effect and limits fit. Creature-specific descriptive text may change its presentation without creating another mechanical ability. Different anatomy can express the same rule: Clinging Recoil works for a corpse's clutch, adhesive flesh or slime. New templates should add a meaningful option rather than rename an existing effect. See the complete action and trope review for assignments, deliberate omissions and the limits of its CV estimates.
